result.summary: The page appears largely intact; the main visible concern is an inconsistent bottom navigation state. Excluded edge-clipped carousel items and viewport-bottom cutoff were treated as expected scrolling behavior.

issues.description: The bottom navigation highlights Profile as the active tab even though the content shown is the Home feed.
issues.suggestion: Set the active navigation state to Home on this screen, or verify the tab state binding so the highlighted tab matches the current page.
